segments.text:
V. 33.
A certain houſholder planted a vineyard—GOD planted the Church in Canaan; And hedged it round about—Firſt with the Law, then with his peculiar Providence: And digged a wine preſs—Perhaps it may mean Jeruſalem: And built a tower—The Temple: And went into a far country—That is, left the Keepers of his Vineyard, in ſome Meaſure, to behave as they ſhould ſee good.
